cluster

layout · 0.1.0 · L2 · aj-l-cluster

A row of children with a gap that wraps when it runs out of room: an action row, a preview's links, a field with its button. It sits on an element that already exists or wraps children; it never knows what its children are. A child takes a placement role with data-place: grow (takes the room left) or fixed (keeps its own size).
